pairs: et summa eorum scripta est in libro regum Israël
And the sum of them was written in the book of the kings of Israel and of Judah.
translatique sunt in Babylonem propter delictum suum.
And they were taken away to Babylon because of their transgression.
Qui autem habitaverunt primi in possessionibus et in urbibus suis:
Now the first who lived in their possessions
and in their cities were Israel,
Commorati sunt in Jerusalem de filiis Juda,
Staying in Jerusalem were some from the sons of Judah,
and from the sons of Benjamin,
and also from the sons of Ephraim
from the sons of Perez, the son of Judah.
Then from the sons of Zerah:
And from the sons of Benjamin:
and Ibneiah, the son of Jeroham;
and Elah, the son of Uzzi,
and Meshullam, the son of Shephatiah,
et fratres eorum per familias suas,
and their brothers according to their families,
Omnes hi principes cognationum per domos patrum suorum.
All these were leaders of their kindred, according to the houses of their fathers.
and also Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
the high priest of the house of God;
then Adaiah, the son of Jeroham,
et Maasai filius Adiel filii Jezra,
and Maasai, the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah,
Fratres quoque eorum principes per familias suas,
and also their brothers, leaders according to their families,
fortissimi robore ad faciendum opus ministerii in domo Dei.
very strong experienced men, for the work of the ministry in the house of God.
Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam,
the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
and Mattaniah, the son of Mica,
and Obadiah, the son of Shemaiah,
and Berechiah, the son of Asa,
who lived at the entrance to Netophah.
and their brother Shallum was the leader.
at the gate of the king to the east,
observabant per vices suas de filiis Levi.
the sons of Levi served in their turns.
Sellum vero filius Core filii Abiasaph,
Truly, Shallum, the son of Kore,
the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
with his brothers and his father’s house,
hi sunt Coritæ super opera ministerii, custodes vestibulorum tabernaculi:
these Korahites, were over the works of the ministry of keeping the vestibules of the tabernacle.
et familiæ eorum per vices castrorum Domini custodientes introitum.
And their families, in turns, were keepers of the entrance to the camp of the Lord.
Phinees autem filius Eleazari erat dux eorum coram Domino.
Now Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, was their ruler before the Lord.
But Zechariah, the son of Meshelemiah,
was the keeper of the gate of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Omnes hi electi in ostiarios per portas,
All these, chosen as porters for the gates,
et descripti in villis propriis, quos constituerunt David,
And they were recorded in their own towns, those whom David,
as with them, so also with their sons,
in ostiis domus Domini et in tabernaculo vicibus suis.
at the gates of the house of the Lord and the tabernacle, by their turns.
At the four directions, there were gatekeepers,
Fratres autem eorum in viculis morabantur,
Now their brothers were staying in the villages,
et veniebant in sabbatis suis de tempore usque ad tempus.
and they arrived on their Sabbaths, from time to time.
His quatuor Levitis creditus erat omnis numerus janitorum,
To these four Levites were entrusted the entire number of the gatekeepers,
et erant super exedras et thesauros domus Domini.
and they were over the chambers and storehouses of the house of the Lord.
Per gyrum quoque templi Domini morabantur in custodiis suis:
And they remained in their watches, on all sides of the temple of the Lord, so that,
they might open the gates in the morning.
De horum genere erant et super vasa ministerii:
Some from their kindred were also over the vessels of the ministry.
ad numerum enim et inferebantur vasa,
For the vessels were both carried in
and carried out according to number.
De ipsis et qui credita habebant utensilia sanctuarii,
Some of them also were entrusted with the equipment of the sanctuary;
they were in charge of the fine wheat flour,
Filii autem sacerdotum unguenta ex aromatibus conficiebant.
Now the sons of the priests composed the ointments from the aromatics.
Et Mathathias Levites primogenitus Sellum Coritæ,
And Mattithiah, a Levite, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite,
præfectus erat eorum quæ in sartagine frigebantur.
was in charge of those things that were cooked in a frying pan.
Porro de filiis Caath fratribus eorum,
Now some of the sons of Kohath, their brothers,
were over the bread of the presence,
ut semper novos per singula sabbata præpararent.
so that they might continually prepare it new for each Sabbath.
Hi sunt principes cantorum per familias Levitarum,
These are the leaders of the singing men, according to the families of the Levites,
who were dwelling in the chambers,
ut die ac nocte jugiter suo ministerio deservirent.
so that they might carry out their ministry continually, day and night.
In Gabaon autem commorati sunt pater Gabaon Jehiel,
Now in Gibeon, there lived Jeiel, the father of Gibeon,
and the name of his wife was Maacah.
isti habitaverunt e regione fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.
These lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, with their brothers.
And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal.
Now the sons of Micah were Pithon,
from of whom was born Azel.
These are the sons of Azel.
